BackPressure.description: What a link does when its queue is at capacity. There is no default (SC-19).

oneOf.description:
Publishing returns [`PublishOutcome::Full`] and nothing is ever dropped.
The name is the Vision's; the policy produces back-pressure through a
refusal the producer must honour, not through a parked thread (SC-20a).
The oldest queued block is evicted (SC-20).

DataContractId.description:
A namespaced contract id matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)+$`,
for example `ezsdr.stream.cf32`.

Rule: SC-2.

DataLinkDecl.description:
A declared link: its endpoints, the contract it carries, its policy and its
capacity in blocks (SC-19).

capacity.description: Queue depth in blocks, at least 1 (SC-19).

contract.description: The contract carried; SC-3 checks it against both ports (SC-19).

policy.description: What happens at capacity; there is no default (SC-19).

DataLinkId.description:
Identifies a [`DataLink`](crate::stream::DataLinkDecl) instance.

Rule: SC-18 (`02-stream-contract.md`), X7.

local.description: Node-local ordinal, allocated by the owning registry.

DeclaredCost.description:
A number the Link Module declares, not a measurement. The Core reports it and
never uses it to choose a placement; Phase 1 neither measures nor optimises.

Rule: SB-40. Vision §20, §31, §63.

cost.description: The Link Module's own number, uninterpreted by the Kernel (SB-40).

ExecutionClass.description:
What kind of Run this is, derived from the environment and cross-checked against
the Authority's [`Pacing`]; a class that was merely declared could lie.

Rule: MA-41, RS-42. Vision §14.

oneOf.description: Simulation Engine, free-running, simulated RF path.
Simulation Engine, wall-paced, simulated RF path.
Device timekeeper, cabled or partly simulated RF path.

Fragment.description: One unit of work handed to one Module at `prepare`, in dependency order (SB-39).

after.description: Fragments that must be prepared and armed first (SB-39).

content.description: What to do; namespaced content the Kernel does not interpret (SB-39).

instance.description: Which exact Module version performs it, as its binding names it (SB-22, D78).

Ident.description:
A name inside one document, matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$`.

Names are compared as bytes; there is no case folding and no Unicode
normalisation, so the canonical form of OV-15 stays byte-comparable.

Rule: SB-1.

ModuleId.description:
Names a Module implementation in the registry (`05-module-api.md` MA-19).

The reverse-DNS-ish namespaced form (`ezsdr.test.provider`) is what keeps two
vendors' Modules from colliding; the Kernel checks the shape, not the authority.

Rule: MA-19.

ModuleRef.description: A Module by id and version (MA-31).

NodeId.description:
A node in the (future) multi-host deployment. `LOCAL` is the only legal value in v4.0.

Rule: X7 (`00-overview.md`); it qualifies every id of TM-11, SC-6, SB-3 and MA-19.

PortRef.description: Names one port of one component instance (SC-1).

port.description: The port name on that component (SC-1).

Role.description:
The five roles. There is exactly one trait each and no shared lifecycle
supertrait: one trait forced onto radios and executors alike is what audit
Finding 22 rejects, and Link and Authority have no lifecycle at all.

Rule: MA-1, MA-2.

class.description:
Derived from the environment and cross-checked against the Authority's
pacing (MA-41, SB-39).

fragments.description: The fragments, already in dependency order (SB-39).

links.description:
The DataLink declarations: the graph's links, then the output feeds, numbered
on from them (SC-19, MA-27a, D75).
